needed.evidence: The zebra crossing is faded and poorly marked on a wide road with high traffic volume.
needed.suggestion: Repaint the zebra crossing with high-visibility thermoplastic paint to improve driver awareness.

needed.evidence: The kerbs at the pedestrian crossing are not dropped, forcing pedestrians to step up and down.
needed.suggestion: Install dropped kerbs at both ends of the crossing to improve accessibility for all users.

needed.evidence: The road has 4 or more lanes but the marked crossing lacks a central refuge island.
needed.suggestion: Construct a pedestrian refuge island in the centre of the road to allow people to cross in two stages.
